content: delta (Rust): Syntax-highlighting pager. Side-by-side via --side-by-side flag. Intra-line word diff via Levenshtein edit inference. Navigation: n/N between hunks/files. Syntax highlighting themes (bat-compatible). Line numbers. Not an interactive TUI — piped from git. No file tree. The gold standard reference implementation for what side-by-side+word-diff looks like.
